recommendation: Refine low-speed final-step rear-foot transitions and short-tread first-step robustness before harder geometry.

scope.geometry_and_reset_matching: Exact geometry, same per-model initial root position arrays, heading control and thresholds.
scope.material_limitation: Startup material parameters are not recorded; separate environment constructions may have different material draws. Reset seeds do not resample startup material/dynamics.
scope.metrics_scope: First measured episode until classification; motion statistics exclude first second.
scope.mean_definition: Arithmetic mean of three seed-level aggregate metrics, not a sample-pooled RMS.
scope.leg_contact_definition: shank_contact_step_fraction covers calf/thigh/shank bodies; not a calf-only metric.
scope.coordinate_definition: maximum_root_relative_x_m and last measured positions are course-relative coordinates; max_progress_m is displacement from randomized reset.
scope.foot_order: Indexed F1..F4. F1/F2 front-positioned, F3/F4 rear-positioned in recorded body order; explicit body names are not stored in evaluation JSON.
scope.terminal_snapshot_limitation: Last valid first-episode positions before auto-reset/classification. Not full trajectories/contact histories; cannot identify causal reward or swing mechanisms.

geometry.collision_representation: closed triangle meshes with physical overhang undersides
